_comment: PROPOSAL ONLY - NOT IN database.rules.json, NOT PUBLISHED (decision 2026-10-07). gps_rules_proposal_test.js merges these two blocks into an in-memory copy of database.rules.json and runs the scenarios against them. docs/gps-rules-proposal.diff is the exact diff they would make.
